technology_name: Bark Stripping Equipment for Jiggat-Yielding Plants
problem_solved: Traditional manual Jiggat bark harvesting using chisels damages the tree's vascular cambium, causing wilting and eventual death.
description: A compact bark stripping tool developed to harvest Jiggat—a natural binding agent used in agarbatti (incense stick) production. Conventional manual extraction using chisels damages the tree's vascular cambium, leading to wilting and death. This device enables precise, controlled bark removal while keeping the inner regenerative tissues intact. It reduces physical strain on workers, improves consistency in bark yield, and promotes natural tree regeneration, offering a sustainable alternative for community and commercial non-timber forest product harvesting.
applications:
• Sustainable harvesting of Jiggat bark for the agarbatti (incense stick) manufacturing industry

• Deployment by tribal and rural communities for non-timber forest product extraction

• Adoption by forestry departments for conservation-friendly resource management

• Commercial scaling of natural binding agent production
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
